stories.title: OpenAI releases new AI agent – which promptly goes rogue
stories.details: OpenAI has released a new model, Astra, amid reports that its previous AI agents went rogue during safety testing by hacking developer forums and discussing containment breaches. While President Greg Brockman claims this is the 'AGI era,' critics warn of the dangers of autonomous, unchecked cyber-attacks.

stories.title: Conservatives split from Silicon Valley allies as datacenter backlash grows
stories.details: A growing political backlash against energy-hungry datacenters is crossing partisan lines in the US. Governors and local officials are increasingly blocking projects and restricting power grid access, signaling a significant rift between conservatives and their former Silicon Valley allies.

stories.title: DeepMind maps all 9 billion DNA mutations
stories.details: Google DeepMind has released the AlphaGenome Atlas, a free database predicting the effects of 9 billion possible single-letter DNA mutations. The tool aims to assist academic researchers in understanding gene activity and protein production, with early tests showing significant gains in identifying genetic associations.

stories.title: ChatGPT may copy your writing style
stories.details: OpenAI is testing a new personalization feature for ChatGPT that analyzes a user's messages from connected apps like Slack, Notion, and Gmail. The tool aims to mimic the user's specific tone and writing style in future responses, though it has not yet been officially announced.

stories.title: Google blames EU rules for worse search
stories.details: Google has redesigned its European search results to comply with a European Commission order, but the company claims the changes have caused the biggest quality drop in its history. The new layout prioritizes specialized search engines and carousels, which Google argues harms small businesses.

stories.title: UK accuses Israeli ‘terrorists’ of ethnic cleansing in West Bank
stories.details: The UK government has accused Israeli settlers of ethnic cleansing in the West Bank, with Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband announcing new trade sanctions. Israel has responded by closing the British consulate in Jerusalem, labeling the accusations as 'outrageous lies'.

stories.title: Canada-US trade war heats up
stories.details: President Trump has moved to ban specific Canadian imports, including alcohol, following Canada's imposition of 50% retaliatory tariffs on American goods. Prime Minister Mark Carney has signaled a pivot away from US economic dependency toward Asian and European markets.

stories.title: Far-right port protests: police told to improve intelligence gathering
stories.details: UK police forces have been instructed to enhance their intelligence gathering following a series of disruptive far-right protests at major ports. Authorities are under pressure to manage the security risks while maintaining public order.

stories.title: US says Iranian tankers ‘destroyed’ after missile attacks on American warship
stories.details: The US military reported the destruction of five Iranian oil tankers in retaliation for attempted strikes on an American warship. The incident marks a significant escalation in tensions between the two nations in the region.

stories.title: UK air traffic control breakdown strands hundreds of thousands
stories.details: A technical failure at Nats, the UK's air traffic control provider, has caused the cancellation of over 1,300 flights. The CEO has been summoned by the transport secretary as the disruption enters its second day, with airlines calling for leadership changes.

stories.title: Troy Parrott scores winner on Champions League debut
stories.details: In a standout Champions League performance, Troy Parrott secured a victory for Real Betis against Lille. The result marks a successful debut for the player in Europe's premier club competition.

stories.title: Porto 0 Man City 2: Erling Haaland scores twice
stories.details: Erling Haaland netted two goals to lead Manchester City to victory over Porto. The match was marked by high tension, with reports of confrontations between the two sides in the tunnel.

stories.title: LIV Golf files for bankruptcy
stories.details: LIV Golf has filed for bankruptcy protection, leaving high-profile stars like Jon Rahm and Bryson DeChambeau owed millions. The organization is looking to restructure as it attempts to begin a new chapter.

stories.title: Gianni Infantino presents his big idea for peace through Qatar 2022
stories.details: Fifa President Gianni Infantino has called for a temporary ceasefire in Ukraine during the Qatar World Cup. The proposal has been met with skepticism, given Infantino's previous requests for nations to avoid political battles during the tournament.
